description: This file defines a PHP trait 'I18nQueryTrait' used in Drupal's migrate module to retrieve internationalization (i18n) translations from the source database. It includes methods for fetching translations for properties not already in a migration row, handling language and object ID lookups, and executing database queries to retrieve translation data.

methods.name: getPropertyNotInRowTranslation
methods.description: Retrieves a translation for a property not already in the migration row, handling language and object ID validation, checking for duplicates, and querying the database for the translation.
